entitycount.config.master_toggle.tooltip: Enable or disable entity count display
entitycount.config.display_mode.tooltip:
All: Show all entities
Living: Show only living entities
entitycount.config.filter_mode.tooltip:
Blacklist: Hide blacklisted entities
Whitelist: Show only whitelisted entities
entitycount.config.text_color.tooltip: Set the text color for entity count display
entitycount.config.background_color.tool: Set the background color and transparency for entity count display
entitycount.config.type_limit.tooltip: Limit the maximum number of entity types displayed, -1 means unlimited
entitycount.config.threshold.tooltip: Only display entity types with count greater than or equal to this value, -1 means no limit
entitycount.config.whitelist_normal.tool: Only show entities in this list (when filter mode is whitelist)
entitycount.config.whitelist_item.toolti: Only show items in this list (when filter mode is whitelist)
entitycount.config.blacklist_normal.tool: Hide entities in this list (when filter mode is blacklist)
entitycount.config.blacklist_item.toolti: Hide items in this list (when filter mode is blacklist)
entitycount.config.pinnedlist_normal.too: Entities in this list will always be displayed at the top
entitycount.config.pinnedlist_item.toolt: Item entities in this list will always be displayed at the top
entitycount.config.pinned_show_even_zero: Show pinned entities even when count is 0
entitycount.config.set_coord_screen.hint: Click and drag to adjust position
entitycount.config.set_coord_screen: Set HUD Position and Size (X, Y, Scale)
entitycount.config.expand_item_display.t: Show detailed item names for dropped items (e.g., Item.Diamond)
entitycount.config.expand_item_display_p:
Some people may want to keep this prefix string
so you can set whether to display it here
(even if items can be displayed in different colors)
entitycount.config.item_entity_color.too: Set the text color for item entity count display
